title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify that E^2 - B^2 and E · B are invariant under Lorentz transformations.

title: Decomposition of Fields
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly decompose the electric and magnetic fields into parallel and perpendicular components.

title: Transformation Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately apply the Lorentz transformation equations for the electric and magnetic fields.

title: Invariant Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive and show that the expressions for E^2 - B^2 and E · B remain unchanged after transformation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as incorrect application of the Lorentz transformation or sign errors.
